paragraphs.text: Even as you spin around and look for a weak point, you know this plan is deranged. Less than two days ago you were taking a coach ride to a new job, and now you are trying to demolish a church whilst still inside it.
Under one section of partially collapsed roof, you see a wooden pillar which is already bowed. You snatch up a piece of broken ironwork.
Make a Hard STR roll. If you succeed, go to 189. If you fail, go to 183.
